section: 5/7/2025Amended by Chapter 173, 2025 General Session2025Penalty for violation.A violation of any of the following sections is a class B misdemeanor:Section 59-14-501, Warning labels required;Section 59-14-502, Requirements for placement of warning labels;Section 59-14-504, Responsibility for placement of warning labels; orSection 59-14-509, Restrictions on mail order or Internet sales.
